author: OPTOBAT
body:
Hey everyone!
Feels nice to finally come back and have a look around at Avicus and all that has changed..
So much nostalgia and reminiscence..

Anyways, if we remember each other be sure to say hi, as some of you have done in game!
I just wanted to say that I am hoping to make a return to Minecraft and Avicus shortly and spend more time on the server again. 
I joined Avicus back in the golden days of late 2013, then kind of quit and went on a hiatus from Minecraft as of about a year ago and didn't really play much since, so this post is to say hey to everyone and i'm back!

See you all in game (hopefully)

- OPTOBAT
